source.installation_note: Only the verified official Python package is exposed through PYTHONPATH; setup.py is not executed because it invokes extra package installation and CUDA-specific dependencies.

licence.verified_from: Code LICENSE at pinned GitHub commit; weight license attached to official Zenodo record 10689643 (metadata.license.id=cc-by-4.0), not a LICENSE file inside the checkpoint.
licence.distribution_note: The Google Drive distribution had a research-only readme. This dossier identifies the Zenodo artifact and does not assume that terms or bytes of other distributions are identical.

weights.training_provenance_note: The paper describes 1570263 medical image-mask pairs and lists datasets in supplementary tables. An exhaustive patient-level training/development manifest for this exact deposited artifact has not been audited. HCC-TACE-Seg is explicitly marked external validation in Supplementary Table 1, not training.
weights.loader_policy: Official loader under TORCH_FORCE_WEIGHTS_ONLY_LOAD=1; no fallback to unrestricted deserialization.

task.transfer_note: POST-TACE lesion refinement on initially occupied axial planes; automatic boxes from a prior POST prediction, not independent expert boxes. Native 3D output does not make the model a volumetric detector.

reported_validation.metric: Dice; no patient-specific or POST accuracy transferred to this study
reported_validation.role: external validation in the original paper
reported_validation.source: Supplementary Table 1 (asterisk denotes external validation), Table 16 (TCIA collection link), and paper validation methods

development_provenance_note: Do not misclassify the paper's external HCC-TACE-Seg benchmark as training or tuning. The complete developed_on list is intentionally unstated pending a full artifact audit; this is an uncertainty, not an assertion that the model used no development data.

evaluation_arms.name: dependent POST refinement engineering comparison; reuse of a published benchmark collection
evaluation_arms.additional_control: HCC_005 baseline preparation failed before model inference because the localized native ROI exceeded four million voxels. The sole replacement HCC_004 also failed baseline preparation at rigid-registration overlap or motion checks. Neither reached MedSAM; no further controls are sought under this protocol.
evaluation_arms.may_claim: Native execution, descriptive changes, technical consistency, and measured resource use only
evaluation_arms.may_not_claim: New independent external validation, anatomical accuracy, clinical non-inferiority, treatment response, or generalization to all 105 cases

hardware.claimed: Official inference script accepts an explicit CPU device
hardware.verified_on: Docker research image, Python 3.12.16, Linux aarch64, torch 2.5.1, two CPU threads, 7 GiB container limit; HCC_006 completed 16 initially occupied native planes and HCC_002 completed 41
hardware.note: HCC_006 completed in 185.4188570419974 seconds, peak process RSS 3630.19921875 MiB; HCC_002 completed in 466.888966044 seconds, peak process RSS 3624.140625 MiB. This verifies execution only, not anatomical accuracy or performance on all cases.

limitations: HCC-TACE-Seg was already an external benchmark of the published method; this is not a new independent collection-level validation.
The source does not establish which HCC patients/scans formed the 70-scan benchmark or validate this POST-TACE target.
The initial mask determines occupied planes and per-plane neighboring-union boxes; the new result is not independent of that prediction.
Non-inferred planes inherit the prior and cannot establish lesion absence or discover new z extent.
A provenance gate finding is not proof of training contamination, nor a clinical performance assessment.
